summary: Better variants measure semantic locality alongside physical size and use the resulting budget to guide retrieval and refactoring.

items.text: Keep related implementation, tests, contracts and documentation in a feature folder so a small unit also has a small navigation radius.
Pair size caps with narrow dependency and public interfaces rather than rewarding file splitting alone.
Compact generated or historical detail while retaining the current contract and dependency boundary in the active context.
Package selected units into typed context sections with explicit provenance and truncation indicators for agents.
